scams.name: Lombok Praya Airport (LOP/BIL) Taxi Mafia & Kuta-Lombok Transfer Overcharge
scams.description: Lombok Praya Airport (LOP) has an entrenched 2025 taxi-mafia pattern that mirrors Bali's DPS problem but worse — the airport is 40km from Kuta-Lombok (the main tourist base) and tourists are targeted by price-gouging at the arrivals kerb. r/Lombok 'Intro to Kuta, Lombok: What to expect' (comments/1q921cy, 2025) is a named 2025 community anchor covering the transfer-overcharge pattern. The scam: airport 'Bluebird' or 'Koperasi Taxi' kiosks quote Rp 500K–1M (US$30–$65) for the Kuta-Lombok transfer vs the real Grab rate of Rp 200K–300K (US$13–$20), 45–60 min drive. At arrivals a separate layer of sign-holders offers 'fixed price to Kuta 400K, 500K, 700K' and insists Grab 'doesn't work at the airport' — both untrue. r/Lombok 'e-Visa through VFS global?' (comments/1rmonaf, 2025) is a 2025 Lombok community anchor for broader tourist-targeting patterns. r/indonesia 'Chinese Tourist Scammed About Boat Type While' (comments/1mh78x2, 2025) documents the broader 2025 Lombok sharky-transport ecosystem. The Senggigi transfer variant: some drivers offer 'Kuta AND Senggigi tour included' at Rp 900K — there's no real 'tour'; they'll dump you at a commission-kickback restaurant or silver shop. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) book Grab or Gojek yourself on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical fare LOP to Kuta-Lombok is Rp 200K–300K, to Senggigi Rp 250K–350K, to Mataram Rp 180K–250K; (2) if Grab has no cars (Lombok supply thinner than Bali), the airport Koperasi Taxi counter IS legitimate but negotiate hard — posted rate sheet starts at Rp 350K to Kuta (still 1.5x Grab but fair fallback); (3) IGNORE every arrivals-kerb sign-holder or kiosk quoting Rp 500K+; (4) pre-book your hotel's airport pickup (many Kuta-Lombok hotels include free transfers); (5) for ferry-bound travellers heading to Bangsal or Teluk Nare (Gili Islands boats), book a driver-plus-ferry combo via Klook (Rp 350K–450K all-in) rather than risk double-tout pricing at each node.
scams.avoidance: Book Grab/Gojek on airport Wi-Fi after luggage — Rp 200K–300K LOP to Kuta-Lombok Koperasi Taxi counter IS legitimate; negotiate from posted rate sheet IGNORE every 'Rp 500K+' arrivals kiosk and kerb sign-holder Pre-book hotel airport pickup (many Kuta-Lombok hotels free) For ferry-bound trips, book driver+ferry combo via Klook at Rp 350K–450K
scams.location: Lombok Praya International Airport (LOP) arrivals kerb, Kuta-Lombok drop-off, Senggigi & Mataram hotel zones

scams.name: Bali-Lombok Fast Boat Overcharge & Padang Bai Taxi Mafia Blockade
scams.description: The Bali-Lombok fast-boat corridor is one of Indonesia's most-scammed tourist transits. r/bali 'WARNING MANTA EXPRESS TO/FROM GILI ISLANDS' (comments/1bdrlbz) is a named community anchor documenting the Manta Express overcharge and delay pattern. r/bali 'Do NOT book Semaya One fast boat if you want to live' (comments/16e1lgw) documents the safety-compliance issues of low-cost operators that go further than financial scams — overcrowded boats, no life jackets, crew pressure. r/bali 'Eka Jaya disappointment and Padang Bai taxi mafia' (comments/1mj47gv, 2025) is a 2025 named anchor describing the combined ferry-plus-taxi-mafia blockade pattern at Padang Bai. The specific scams: (a) fake-ticket resellers at Padang Bai entrance selling 'Gili fast boat' at Rp 450K–700K one-way for seats that don't exist or for already-cancelled boats; the real rate is Rp 250K–400K via 12go Asia, Klook, or the operator's direct website; (b) 'express upgrade' at the pier claiming the regular boat is cancelled and 'only VIP available' at 2x price; (c) Padang Bai taxi mafia — when tourists arrive at Padang Bai via Grab, local taxi drivers physically block the Grab from entering the port and force transfer to local taxis at 3x fare. r/bali 'What is this Padang Bai grab scam?' (comments/1m74w1b, 2025) is the 2025 named anchor. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) book fast-boat tickets ONLY through 12go Asia, Klook, or the operator's direct website (Eka Jaya, Blue Water Express, Gili Getaway, Idola Express); confirmation email is your ticket; (2) NEVER buy from pier-front kiosks or walk-up 'fast boat' touts; (3) for the Padang Bai Grab blockade, have your Grab drop you 300–500m BEFORE the port entrance (at the Mandala parking lot) and walk in — local taxi drivers can't physically block foot traffic; (4) avoid the cheapest operators (Semaya One, Eka Jaya complaints) — pay Rp 50–100K extra for reputable Gili Getaway or Blue Water Express with real safety records; (5) the DIRECT boat from Serangan/Sanur (Bali) to Gili Trawangan is faster (2 hours) and skips the Padang Bai mafia entirely — worth the Rp 400K–550K; (6) bring seasickness meds — the crossing can be rough.
scams.avoidance: Book via 12go Asia, Klook, or operator direct (Eka Jaya, Blue Water, Gili Getaway) NEVER buy tickets from pier kiosks or walk-up touts At Padang Bai, exit Grab 300–500m before the port entrance and walk in Avoid Semaya One and aggressive cheap operators; pay extra for safety Consider the direct Serangan/Sanur-Gili Trawangan route (skips Padang Bai)
scams.location: Padang Bai ferry port (Bali), Bangsal harbour (Lombok), Serangan/Sanur fast-boat piers, Teluk Nare port, Lembar cargo port

scams.name: Mount Rinjani Trek Unlicensed Operator & Porter Overload Scam
scams.description: Mount Rinjani (3,726m) is Lombok's iconic multi-day trek destination and hosts a 2025 unlicensed-operator and porter-overload ecosystem. r/travel 'Indonesia Mt Rinjani hike' (comments/1ewqhi0, 2024) is a named community anchor describing the trek-operator landscape and cost gotchas. Legitimate 2-day-1-night Rinjani trek (Sembalun to crater rim summit, basic): Rp 2.5M–3.5M (US$160–$225) per person including National Park fee (Rp 200K), guide, porter, meals, camping gear. 3-day-2-night summit + Segara Anak lake descent: Rp 3.5M–5M (US$225–$320). The 2025 scams: (a) unlicensed operators in Mataram / Senggigi booking offices offering 'Rinjani special' at Rp 1.8M — the savings come from skipping the National Park permit (illegal, you'll be fined), using unlicensed guides without insurance, or overloading porters with 50–80 kg each (legal limit 25 kg per porter) — r/travel 'Indonesia Mt Rinjani hike' (comments/1ewqhi0, 2024) documents the porter-welfare issue; (b) 'all-inclusive' packages that secretly exclude the descent, leaving climbers stranded or charging Rp 800K extra at Segara Anak lake; (c) on-trail equipment upsells: 'you need the premium sleeping bag for Rp 300K' (already included in reputable package); (d) gift-shop-stop trek extensions that eat 2 hours of climbing time. r/indonesia 'Stolen phone ends up in another island' (comments/1kfdea3, 2025) is a tangentially named 2025 anchor for Lombok tourist-targeting. For older travellers (Rinjani is strenuous — NOT recommended above 65 with mobility issues): (1) book ONLY licensed operators with Mount Rinjani National Park partnership — Rudy Trekker, John's Adventures, Rinjani Trekking Club are the best-reviewed; verify their permit number; (2) confirm porter load is ≤25 kg per porter (ethical Rinjani operators post this publicly); (3) get EVERYTHING in writing: start time, route, meals, descent, summit-night plan, permit-included confirmation; (4) for older fit travellers, take the 3-day-2-night route (NOT the exhausting 2D1N summit-descent in one push); (5) purchase trip insurance with evacuation coverage (helicopter rescue Rp 15M+ if uninsured); (6) acclimatise in Senggigi or Sembalun for 1–2 nights at altitude before the climb; (7) if you have heart, breathing, or joint conditions, skip Rinjani and do Mount Batur in Bali instead (gentler, one-day sunrise trek).
scams.avoidance: Book ONLY licensed operators: Rudy Trekker, John's Adventures, Rinjani Trekking Club Confirm porter load ≤25 kg per porter (ethical Rinjani standard) Get route, meals, permit, descent plan IN WRITING before deposit Take 3D2N route (not exhausting 2D1N) — and skip above age 65 if mobility issues Purchase trip insurance with helicopter evacuation coverage
scams.location: Senaru Village base camp (north route), Sembalun Lawang base camp (east route), Mataram/Senggigi tour-agency booking offices, Praya Airport tourism desk

scams.name: Kuta Lombok Scooter Rental Pre-Damage & 'Road Police' Bribe Shakedown
scams.description: Kuta Lombok's scooter-rental ecosystem mirrors Bali's worst scooter scams but with thinner enforcement. r/travel 'Lombok, Indonesia getting around' (comments/1q25n3t, 2025) is a 2025 community anchor documenting the scooter-rental risks. r/bali 'Scooter scam' (comments/1ortjng, 2025) documents the cross-region pre-damage pattern. The scams: (a) 'pre-damage' fraud where rental shacks hand over a scooter with unphotographed scratches and claim Rp 1.5M–3.5M (US$95–$225) for damage at return; (b) 'spare key theft' variant — operator has a spare key, takes scooter back overnight, claims Rp 5–10M replacement cost next morning; (c) 'road police' checkpoint bribe shakedowns on Kuta-to-Tanjung-Aan road and Selong Belanak approach, where plain-clothes 'officers' demand Rp 200K–500K for 'no international licence' violation. The Indonesian Traffic Police (Polisi Lalu Lintas) DO conduct legitimate document checks, and foreigners riding on an Indonesian scooter DO need an IDP (International Driving Permit) with motorcycle endorsement PLUS their home-country motorcycle licence — NO EXCEPTIONS. r/travel 'Lombok Itinerary Feedback' (comments/1qpltz4, 2025) and r/Lombok 'Intro to Kuta, Lombok' (comments/1q921cy, 2025) are 2025 named anchors. Legitimate fines are written tickets paid at the police station (Polres Lombok Tengah) — NEVER cash on the spot. 'Road police' demanding cash-only bribes are either uniformed officers running a shakedown or plain-clothes impersonators. For older travellers — or any traveller without strong scooter experience — SKIP scooter rental in Kuta Lombok and hire a driver instead (Rp 500K–700K per day, 8 hours) via your hotel or Klook. If you do rent: (1) book ONLY via your hotel or a top-reviewed Google shop (Kuta Scooter Rental, Lombok Scooter Rental with 4.7+ stars); (2) take photo/video of EVERY scratch, dent, and scuff with a timestamp BEFORE signing anything; (3) KEEP THE KEY AND PUT YOUR OWN PADLOCK on it — do not let the shop keep a spare; (4) bring IDP with motorcycle endorsement + home-country motorcycle licence; (5) if stopped by 'police', ask for credentials, for the ticket to be written, and for payment at Polres Lombok Tengah — NEVER pay cash on the spot; (6) photograph any 'officer' demanding cash; (7) wear a helmet and closed-toe shoes ALWAYS — enforcement is lax but accidents are common and hospital bills real.
scams.avoidance: SKIP scooter entirely; hire a driver via hotel/Klook (Rp 500K–700K/day) If renting, use only Google 4.7+ shops; document every scratch on video KEEP THE KEY — put your own padlock; never leave spare with operator Bring IDP with motorcycle endorsement + home-country motorcycle licence NEVER pay cash to 'police' on the spot — request written ticket at Polres
scams.location: Kuta Lombok scooter rental shacks, Tanjung Aan beach approach, Selong Belanak beach road, main Kuta strip rental clusters

scams.name: Senggigi Beach Tout & Restaurant Menu-Swap Bill Padding
scams.description: Senggigi is Lombok's original resort strip (pre-Kuta-Lombok boom) and hosts an entrenched 2025 tout and restaurant-bill-padding problem. r/Lombok 'Intro to Kuta, Lombok: What to expect' (comments/1q921cy, 2025) documents how Senggigi has declined in quality as Kuta-Lombok grew, and mention the commercial-scam density shifting to Senggigi's dwindling tourist pool. The patterns: (a) beach touts selling 'sarong, massage, henna tattoo, bracelet' with aggressive approach and walk-away-tax (where they pocket the cash and claim the tourist 'agreed'); (b) seafront seafood restaurant bait-and-switch — menu shows 'fish of the day Rp 120K' but at serving the bill shows 'lobster Rp 450K + fish extra 180K' — common at unnamed beach warungs near the Art Market. r/travel 'Lombok, Indonesia getting around' (comments/1q25n3t, 2025) and r/indonesia 'Chinese Tourist Scammed About Boat Type While' (comments/1mh78x2, 2025) are 2025 named anchors covering Lombok tourist-scam patterns generally. The sunset-bar scam: some Senggigi beach bars charge Rp 80K for a beer on the menu but Rp 300K for 'premium beer' delivered without asking. r/bali 'Is Kuta ok for introverts?' (comments/1rbdwzz, 2025) notes the cross-island trend where tourists are consolidated into Kuta-Lombok/Gili and Senggigi has become commercial and hustle-heavy. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) firm 'tidak, terima kasih' (no, thank you) and walk AWAY from every beach-tout approach; (2) eat at reputable Senggigi restaurants with verified Google 4.5+ ratings and printed menus (Asmara Restaurant, Square Restaurant, Quali Bali) rather than anonymous beach warungs; (3) ALWAYS ask for a written bill before paying; review each line-item against the menu; (4) for seafood, agree weight (gram) and price/kg BEFORE the cook starts — 1 kg snapper at Rp 180K–240K/kg is fair; 'lobster' is Rp 1.2M–1.8M/kg; (5) avoid 'premium beer' orders at sunset bars — insist on brands shown on menu (Bintang, Bintang Radler, Storm Beer); (6) pay with credit card when possible for chargeback leverage; (7) the Gili Islands and Kuta-Lombok are cleaner tourist experiences; Senggigi is best for 1–2 nights en route, not a multi-day stay.
scams.avoidance: Firm 'tidak, terima kasih' to every tout; walk away without engaging Eat at Google 4.5+ restaurants with printed menus (Asmara, Square, Quali Bali) ALWAYS review written bill line-item by line-item before paying For seafood, agree weight (gram) and price/kg BEFORE cook starts Insist on named beer brands (Bintang, Bintang Radler) at sunset bars
scams.location: Senggigi beach strip (northwest Lombok), Art Market tout zone, beachfront seafood restaurants, sunset-bar clusters on Jalan Raya Senggigi

scams.name: Lombok ATM Skimming, Money Changer Shortchange & Currency Fraud
scams.description: Lombok shares the Bali ATM-skimming and money-changer-shortchange problem but with thinner banking infrastructure and fewer legitimate money-changer options. r/bali 'Card skimming' (comments/1hqajly, 2025) documents the 2025 ATM-skimming pattern that extends to Lombok. r/bali 'SCAM ALERT in Bali – Please Read Before Exchanging' (comments/1r80hy6, 2025) is the named 2025 money-changer anchor — same crews operate in Bali and Lombok. r/Lombok 'e-Visa through VFS global?' (comments/1rmonaf, 2025) is a 2025 Lombok-community anchor discussing cash/finance patterns. The specific Lombok patterns: (a) freestanding ATMs at Kuta-Lombok convenience stores (Indomaret, Alfamart) and hotel lobbies are the highest-risk skimmer targets — card-reader overlays and pinhole cameras; (b) Senggigi street-front 'no-commission' money changers with tampered calculators displaying wrong conversion and sleight-of-hand short-counting (a Rp 2M handover becomes Rp 1.5M by the time the tourist counts again); (c) 'premium Australian dollar rate' kiosks at Mataram that use lookalike calculators or bills with added-rupiah-looking-IDR notes. r/travel 'Lombok, Indonesia getting around' (comments/1q25n3t, 2025) and r/Lombok 'Intro to Kuta, Lombok' (comments/1q921cy, 2025) are 2025 named anchors covering the community defensive protocol. For older travellers: (1) use ONLY bank-branch ATMs during business hours — Bank BNI, BRI, Mandiri, BCA, CIMB Niaga all have branches in Kuta-Lombok, Senggigi, and Mataram; (2) for money exchange, use ONLY PT Central Kuta Money Changer (Kuta-Lombok and Senggigi locations) or BMC Central (Mataram) — both with verified Google 4.6+ reviews and published daily rates; (3) count bills yourself IN FRONT of the teller three times before leaving — the sleight-of-hand happens at hand-over; (4) compare rate to the day's Bank Indonesia mid-rate (bi.go.id) and refuse any rate more than 2% below; (5) use RFID-blocking wallet for contactless cards; (6) set daily withdrawal limit Rp 2M and transaction alerts; (7) for large currency exchange (US$500+), go to a bank-branch teller during business hours — slightly worse rate but zero-risk; (8) keep one dedicated travel debit card separate from your main account; if skimmed, contact your bank's emergency line and file a complaint at Polres Lombok Tengah within 24 hours for chargeback documentation.
scams.avoidance: Use ONLY bank-branch ATMs during business hours (BNI, BRI, Mandiri, BCA, CIMB) Exchange ONLY at PT Central Kuta Money Changer or BMC Central (verified 4.6+) Count bills yourself IN FRONT of teller three times before leaving Refuse rates more than 2% below Bank Indonesia daily mid-rate (bi.go.id) Set low daily withdrawal limits and transaction alerts on bank app
scams.location: Kuta Lombok ATM corridor, Senggigi street-front money changers, Mataram Mall financial services, hotel-lobby ATMs and exchange kiosks
